mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a temperature of 75 degrees with overcast skies over the Verona Area High School, and a waxing gibbous moon is currently lighting up the night sky.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest is open for students in grades K through 12 until July 22, with winners having their designs featured in the November election. Also, residents are reminded to review the mailbox damage policy to ensure mailboxes are ready for the winter plowing season.

For your weekend plans, we have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and next week features trivia nights at Hop Haus and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police update, on July 13, an officer arrested a 36-year-old man for an O-W-I after he was found with his vehicle stuck on a large rock.
You are in luck because today's flavor is Oreo Cookie Overload. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so plan your visit to enjoy this delicious treat.
